headline: Give your senior dog extra years together
body: Keep your furry family member active with our vet-recommended, grain-free formula. Full ingredient transparency means you always know what goes into their bowl.
rationale: This persona treats their dog as a family member and carefully checks ingredient labels. The copy uses exact messaging preferences like vet-recommended and ingredient transparency while speaking directly to the emotional connection of wanting more healthy years with a senior pet, avoiding any generic or cheap positioning.
